annotations.title: What it costs to trade one ETF

description: What it costs to trade one ETF: its IQ Liquidity Score on a fixed 0 to 100 scale, the bid-ask spread and premium or discount to NAV the issuer publishes under Rule 6c-11, ETFIQ's own premium from NAV and closing prices with its window, and, where a number is not published, why. The lead sentence is quoted from the fund's trading page.

ticker.description: One fund's ticker, such as JEPI.

name: etf_trading_cost
